# Observed harness friction

2026-10-23, Codex collaboration tool. Deep review requests explicitly containing
`[critic]` were rejected as worker-tier spawns. The requested model was
`gpt-6.1-sol` at high effort; ordinary permitted `gpt-6-sol` reviews then completed.
The rejection is real; its root cause is unproven. This is no authorization to
loosen model-tier policy, bypass a hook, or change global configuration.

CG-15 qualification should replay the actual host-native request envelope, including
the brief's field name, role, marker, fork mode, model and effort. Check the adapter
and active binary revision before changing policy. A configuration's intended role
does not prove how the boundary classified the invocation. Keep the denial event and
permitted recovery as separate outcomes; measure false holds as well as prevention.

Disposition: deferred controlled reproduction under the owning harness, not a source
fix or installation in this change. The independent reviews used for delivery are
linked in the security/Assignment Kit review receipts, with their actual scope.
